_meta.verified_by: Only the no_income_tax list is verified here — it is statutory, not inflation-indexed, and stable across years. Rate data for individual states carries its OWN per-state `verified` flag and is unverified until an owner checks it.
_meta.source: no_income_tax list: state constitutions/statutes. Per-state rates: UNVERIFIED, see each state's `verified` field.
_meta.purpose: PER-STATE verification, because the confidence genuinely differs. 'Texas has no income tax' is a fact that does not move; 'Illinois is 4.95%' is a number that changes by legislature. A single file-level flag would force both to the lower confidence and make the engine useless, or both to the higher and make it dishonest.
_meta.policy: A state absent from every section raises UNMODELLED_STATE. It is NEVER treated as zero — a silent zero would understate a Californian's total tax by five figures and look like a complete answer.

no_income_tax.note: No tax on wage/salary income. NH and WA tax some investment/capital-gains income but not wages, so a wage-only calculation is correctly zero; a capital-gains question in those states is NOT answered by this calculator.

caveats.NH: No wage income tax. Interest & dividends tax was phased out (repealed from 2025).
caveats.WA: No wage income tax, but a 7% tax applies to long-term capital gains above a statutory standard deduction.
